status: PRE-REGISTERED FORECAST -- NOT PUBLISHED AS A FORECAST
what_this_is: A prediction sealed before the event so that the post-election evaluation is out-of-sample. It is not a published forecast and carries no editorial claim; see blog/posts/05-the-forecast-i-am-not-publishing.md.

assumptions: shrinkage factor swept over [0.25, 0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]; it is an assumption, not an estimate
the specials swing is measured against presidential baselines and applied to a House basis
caveats: Specials are a non-random sample of seats; they occur where a vacancy happened.
Special-election turnout composition differs from a general electorate.
Overperformance is an association with the national environment, not a measure of it.
Margin-based, so it controls for turnout level but not turnout composition.
shrinkage is an assumption, not an estimate; no historical calibration exists yet
specials over-represent high-engagement voters, so the raw mean is biased upward
std_error covers sampling spread across specials only, not shrinkage error
the swing is measured against presidential baselines and applied to a House basis

conclusions: House: Democrats favored at every assumption in the band (P(control) 0.536–0.770).

Senate: control depends on the assumption -- Democrats favored only at shrinkage=1 (P(Dem control) 0.272–0.545). The band cannot resolve this chamber; narrowing it (NE-002) or an identified estimator (NE-003) would.
declared_defects: 173 House seats have no prior on their 2026 boundaries. They use their state's presidential lean with sigma 0.1450 against a modelled 0.1121. RD-003's vote transfer is unbuilt, so these seats are the least informed part of the chamber and should show visibly worse per-seat scores.

The derived Democratic Senate caucus is 45 of 100, two short of the actual 47. The candidate/party crosswalk (P0-003) cannot resolve every member's affiliation from two-party share, so Senate Democratic seats are likely understated by about two.

Renomination is assumed for every sitting member. 458 have a 2026 FEC filing and 10 were not found; primaries are not compiled at all, so retirements and primary defeats are invisible to this forecast.
The national environment is unidentified. The shrinkage factor is an assumption swept over, not an estimate, and no historical calibration for it exists yet (NE-002 open).

Maps in AL, LA, MO, TN are under live litigation and could move before election day. The register records the plan in effect at the snapshot date; a late court order would invalidate those seats' boundaries.
The simulation's correlated-error split (45/25/30 national/regional/state) is asserted, not estimated from residuals. Chamber-level interval width is sensitive to it.

evaluation_plan.scored_on: 2026-11-03 certified returns, once available from the states (not calls, not unofficial counts)
evaluation_plan.basis: two-party Democratic vote share; uncontested races handled as in the backtest, never as 100-0
evaluation_plan.every_assumption_is_scored: All five shrinkage assumptions are scored and all five reported. Selecting the best-performing one after the fact is forbidden and would void this registration.
per_seat_metrics: expected calibration error and a reliability curve over the same 10 bins as the backtest
90% and 95% interval coverage from mean_dem_share +/- z * sigma
chamber_metrics: absolute error on mean Democratic seat count
whether the realised seat count fell inside the 90% simulation interval
whether the band's directional claim held (House favoured Democratic at every assumption)
comparators_fixed_in_advance: naive persistence: each seat repeats its own 2024 two-party share
state-lean fallback applied to ALL seats, not just the 173 redrawn ones
the backtest's own leave-one-cycle-out House MAE of 0.078694 as the in-sample reference
evaluation_plan.failure_condition: If the realised Democratic seat count falls outside the 90% interval under every assumption in the band, the model's stated uncertainty was too narrow. This is a failure of the forecast, not of the band, and is to be reported as such.
evaluation_plan.split_evaluation_required: Per-seat metrics must be reported separately for the 262 seats projected from the model and the 173 projected from the state-lean fallback. A single pooled number would hide which half of the chamber the model actually knows anything about.

data_snapshots.compiled special elections: 11 rows compiled through 2026-07-28; 8 used after same-party and seat double-count gating
